title: ResetRequest
description: Request to reboot the station. There is exactly ONE reset operation and it is a reboot: the station restarts its firmware and everything persisted survives. No value of this message clears credentials, and no remote factory reset exists in OSPP — factory reset is PHYSICAL (a button, or an SD card), for the reason given in the Reset profile: OSPP keeps no bootstrap credential that would survive a wipe, so a remote wipe would make the station unreachable by every channel it has.

force.description: Whether to reboot even while a session is running. Omitted or false: the station REFUSES if any bay has an active session, answering 3016 ACTIVE_SESSIONS_PRESENT, and the operator stops the sessions or waits. True: the station settles every active session under the operator-disable policy FIRST (04-flows.md, 'The operator-disable policy') — the session is stopped, metered from the time ACTUALLY DELIVERED, and reported as SessionEnded with reason OperatorStopped, so the customer is billed for what they received — and only then reboots. Force is not a licence to drop a session on the floor; it is a licence to end it without waiting.
